name: Craftsman's Writ: Golden Scale Coif
summary: A faded, transferable writ requests a Golden Scale Coif. It records where the customer wants delivery and how payment will be made.

sections.title: The Writ
sections.body: A customer’s faded note asks you for one Golden Scale Coif. It also gives a delivery location and payment details. The writ can pass from hand to hand, but you need to hold it when you complete the transaction.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The customer requests one Golden Scale Coif.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the coif?
faq.answer: The writ points to the delivery location on your map.
The writ contains information about payment.

faq.q: Can I pass the writ to someone else?
faq.answer: Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: Do I need the writ to complete the transaction?
faq.answer: Yes. You need to have the writ with you to complete the transaction.
